name: railway-operator
description: Autonomous Railway operator, running on the session model (always the strongest available Claude), that executes any Railway task end-to-end. CLI-first (all 34 subcommands plus GraphQL when the CLI lacks a mutation), Playwright-second (falls back to the railway.com dashboard for UI-only actions and prompts you to sign in when needed). Applies well-known Railway gotchas (volume-add-no-redeploy, PGDATA subdirectory, IPv6 private DNS, Cloudflare SSL Flexible loop, RAILWAY_START_COMMAND Railpack-only, SSH arg re-tokenization) automatically and verifies every mutation. Can cite a local Railway knowledge base and GoodMem Learnings if you have them configured.
